answer: Because the timing is recorded against the jade challenge, the bridge audit can replay the canyon history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm thus has to pad 35 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which burns the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 4501 identities would post 2950 proofs and burn roughly 28 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
